name: Live sessions
author: Brett
description: Every Claude session going on, on every account: human (Claude Code terminals, claude.ai chats and voice calls, the AmberX / Gizmo companion) and headless (claude -p builds, agent-swarm jobs), each with a Human / Headless badge and the agent running it, in a grid (or a list) with filters. A banner widget counts them ('2 human · 4 headless'). Watch live streams any session's messages, tool calls and results; voice (both sides, through AmberX) only on human sessions. Brett only; every watch is logged, and the watched human sees 'You're being watched' (plus a Breakroom line). Every human session is recorded by default (redacted context-window log + voice) and plays back in real time in the Session browser; the silence is cut out after the session ends. Recordings go to their own container, with mirrors in a VPS container, a private repo (Git LFS) or a device.
